title: Sets
summary: A set stores unique values with no particular order. Adding a duplicate does nothing — the set simply keeps one copy.
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program
Predict program output by reading code

sections.content: A set stores unique values with no particular order. Adding a duplicate does nothing — the set simply keeps one copy.
Sets answer membership questions fast: "have we seen this value before?" They also support union, intersection, and difference operations.
Key points: use sets to deduplicate lists, sets cannot be indexed by position, and membership tests are near-instant.

tags = {"python", "code", "python"}
; tags now holds only 2 unique values
